description: BR-PVGen - The Brazilian Photovoltaic Generation Dataset is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Caian Dutra de Jesus, Rhuan Nascimento Ferreira (Universidade Federal de Juiz de Fora). BR-PVGen is an open-access dataset comprising synchronized, high-resolution operational and meteorological measurements from 51 distributed photovoltaic (PV) plants located across different climatic regions of Brazil. Data were collected via a cloud-based SCADA system between March 26, 2024 and June 9, 2025, and are standardized to a 15-minute temporal resolution. Coverage: national (BR); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
